system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: the controller, engineer and researcher are made aware of the output of the previous steps in the plan via a common block injected into their system message

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: These agents leverage Retrieved Augmented Generation (RAG) methods, with their contexts made of chunks of information that are retrieved from a vector embedding of the full database using similarity search
env_context_strategy.note: Context agents inject full library docs into system message (Sec. 2.2) plus RAG agents; closest value mixed.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: At the end of every step in the plan, the agents and the entire chat history are reset and only the system context is carried over to the next step.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: an executor agent that executes the provided code block locally
tool_call_format.note: Installer agent also runs bash pip install.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: Given an input task, the system first goes through a Planning phase in which a plan is designed and approved. A Control phase follows, in which the plan is executed by the Control agents.
loop_primitives.note: Failed executions retried up to nfails with interpreter suggestions. One Shot mode also offered (Sec. 4).

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: Once the definitive plan is approved by the reviewer, it is stored into context and saved as a JSON file

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: The key agent of the Control phase is the controller, which distributes the assigned sub-tasks in the plan to the relevant agents.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: The execution output is then forwarded to a post-execution interpreter agent, which decides on which agent to transfer to.
delegation_mechanism.note: AG2 swarm-style transfers; engineer uses nested chat.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: there is no human-in-the-loop at any point in either phase
human_in_loop.note: Paper Sec. 4 mentions a Human-in-the-loop mode for less complex tasks; gating points unspecified.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: the context variables that have been updated by the agents are recorded and passed on to the start of the next step

self_verification.evidence_quote: the plan reviewer, which provides feedback on the proposed plan
self_verification.note: Execution outputs judged by a post-execution interpreter agent.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: If the number of failed execution is less than nfails (a hyperparameter that can be specified by the user), the subsystem typically transits back to the engineer for another attempt

termination_condition.evidence_quote: If the number of failed executions reaches nfails, the system transitions to a terminator agent and the full session ends.
termination_condition.note: Ends when all subtasks completed (Fig. 1) or nfails reached.

cost_controls.note: Cost displayed/stored but no cap reported; history reset reduces cost.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: an executor agent that executes the provided code block locally

tracing.evidence_quote: for traceability, the structured responses of each agent (the plans and the plan feedback) are recorded into the session context by recorder agents

eval_hooks.note: Evaluation code referenced but location not stated.

target_domain.evidence_quote: We present a multi-agent system for automation of scientific research tasks, cmbagent.

open_source.evidence_quote: The source code is available on GitHub

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: its agents leverage state-of-the-art LLMs through API interfaces with OpenAI, Google, and Anthropic

primary_artifact.evidence_quote: The source code is available on GitHub
primary_artifact.note: Only paper evidence available; no pinned repo version supplied.
